articles.title: OpenAI Launches GPT-5 with Extended Reasoning and Native Multimodal Generation
articles.summary: OpenAI officially released GPT-5, featuring substantially improved long-horizon reasoning, native image and audio generation within a single model, and a 1M-token context window. Benchmarks show significant gains on PhD-level science questions and complex multi-step coding tasks, positioning it as a major leap over GPT-4o. Enterprise API access includes a new 'planning mode' that chains tool use autonomously.

articles.title: Google DeepMind's Gemini Ultra 2 Achieves State-of-the-Art on Agentic Benchmarks
articles.summary: DeepMind unveiled Gemini Ultra 2 with a focus on agentic capabilities, demonstrating autonomous multi-step web browsing, code repository management, and research synthesis. The model topped new agentic benchmarks including WebArena and SWE-Bench Verified by wide margins. Google integrated it directly into Workspace as an always-on assistant capable of executing multi-hour workflows.

articles.title: Tesla Optimus Gen 3 Begins Limited Deployment in Automotive Factories
articles.summary: Tesla started deploying its third-generation Optimus humanoid robots in two of its Gigafactories for parts sorting, inspection, and light assembly tasks. The Gen 3 units feature improved dexterous manipulation with 22-DOF hands and on-device vision-language models for real-time task adaptation. Musk stated the goal is 1,000 units operating in Tesla facilities by year-end before external sales begin in 2027.

articles.title: Figure AI Raises $1.5B Series C as Its Humanoid Robots Enter Warehouse Operations
articles.summary: Figure AI closed a $1.5 billion Series C at a $15 billion valuation, with investment from Microsoft, NVIDIA, and Amazon. The company's Figure 02 robots are now operating in BMW logistics centers and Amazon fulfillment warehouses, handling unstructured pick-and-place tasks. The funding will accelerate development of Figure 03, which promises full-body loco-manipulation for outdoor and construction environments.

articles.title: Anthropic Introduces Constitutional Classifiers for Enterprise AI Safety at Scale
articles.summary: Anthropic released a production-grade safety layer called Constitutional Classifiers, enabling enterprises to define custom safety policies in natural language that are enforced across Claude deployments in real time. The system uses lightweight classifier heads trained via constitutional AI methods, adding less than 50ms latency while reducing policy violations by over 90% in red-team evaluations. The approach is positioned as a practical alternative to heavy-handed content filtering.

articles.title: TSMC Begins Volume Production of 1.4nm Process Node Ahead of Schedule
articles.summary: TSMC announced it has commenced high-volume manufacturing on its A14 (1.4nm-class) process node at its Fab 20 facility in Tainan, several months ahead of its original timeline. The node delivers an 18% speed improvement and 25% power reduction over N2, with backside power delivery fully integrated. Apple, NVIDIA, and AMD are confirmed as launch customers, with chips expected in consumer devices by early 2027.

articles.title: Neuralink Receives FDA Clearance for Second-Generation Brain-Computer Interface Implant
articles.summary: The FDA granted Neuralink clearance to begin expanded clinical trials of its N2 implant, which doubles the electrode count to 2,048 channels and introduces wireless charging. Early trial participants with spinal cord injuries demonstrated cursor control speeds approaching able-bodied benchmarks and preliminary speech decoding capabilities. The clearance marks a significant regulatory milestone for commercial brain-computer interfaces.

articles.title: EU AI Act Enforcement Begins with First Compliance Audits of Foundation Model Providers
articles.summary: The European AI Office initiated its first formal compliance audits under the EU AI Act's provisions for general-purpose AI models, targeting OpenAI, Google, and Meta's European operations. Auditors are examining training data documentation, systemic risk assessments, and red-teaming practices. The enforcement action is being closely watched as a template for how regulators worldwide will hold foundation model developers accountable.
